passages.title: 신제품 출시 일정 조정 메일
passages.passage:
From: Product Management
To: Launch Working Group
Subject: Launch Date Moved to October 14

Team,

After reviewing the beta test results, we are moving the launch of the Atlas app from September 23 to October 14. Two issues drove this decision: battery use on older phones remains above our target, and the sign-up flow confused several test users at the payment step.

Engineering will deliver fixes by September 26, followed by a second beta round of two weeks. Marketing should hold all public materials until the new date is confirmed at the October 1 checkpoint; press partners will be notified individually this week.

The good news: testers rated the core features 4.6 out of 5, and early press interest is stronger than for any previous release. Three extra weeks protect that first impression.

Questions to the launch channel, please.

Dana Wolfe
Head of Product

questions.q: Why was the launch postponed?
choices: Battery use and a confusing sign-up flow
questions.exKo: 구형 폰 배터리 소모와 결제 단계의 혼란, 두 가지 문제 때문입니다.

questions.q: What happens after engineering delivers fixes?
questions.exKo: 수정 후 2주간 2차 베타 테스트를 진행합니다.

questions.q: What does Ms. Wolfe imply about the delay?
choices: It protects the product's first impression
questions.exKo: 3주의 여유가 좋은 첫인상을 지켜 준다고 강조합니다.

passages.title: 장기 근속 기념 행사 안내 메일
passages.passage:
From: Office of the CEO
To: All Staff
Subject: Celebrating 25 Years — Anniversary Week

Dear colleagues,

Next month marks 25 years since our company shipped its first order from a rented garage. To celebrate, Anniversary Week runs June 9-13 with events at every site.

Highlights include a history exhibition in each lobby, a Thursday food festival with dishes from the eight countries where we operate, and Friday afternoon off for all staff. Employees who have served 10, 15, and 20 years will be honored at Wednesday's ceremony, which will be streamed live for remote colleagues.

We are also giving back: for every employee who volunteers at least two hours with our community partners during June, the company will donate $100 to that organization.

Thank you for building this company. Details and schedules are on the anniversary intranet page.

Martin Hoyt, CEO

questions.q: What happens on Friday of Anniversary Week?
questions.exKo: 금요일 오후는 전 직원 휴무입니다.

questions.q: Who will be honored at the ceremony?
choices: Employees with 10, 15, and 20 years of service
questions.exKo: 근속 10·15·20년 직원이 수요일 기념식에서 표창받습니다.

questions.q: How does the company support employee volunteering?
questions.exKo: 6월에 2시간 이상 봉사한 직원 1인당 100달러를 해당 단체에 기부합니다.

passages.title: 전기차 충전소 설치 공지
passages.passage:
EV CHARGING STATIONS — PARKING LEVEL 2

Eight electric vehicle charging points are now operating on parking level 2, near the west elevators. Charging is free for employees during a six-month introduction period; afterward, a per-hour fee comparable to public stations will apply.

To start charging, scan your employee badge at the unit. Sessions are limited to four hours so that more drivers can charge each day; the unit sends a phone alert 15 minutes before your session ends, and cars left connected after the limit may be moved by security.

Spaces beside the chargers are for actively charging vehicles only. Demand will be reviewed monthly, and four more points will be added if average utilization stays above 80 percent.

Facilities Team

questions.q: What happens after the six-month introduction period?
questions.exKo: 이후에는 공공 충전소 수준의 시간당 요금이 부과됩니다.

questions.q: Why are sessions limited to four hours?
choices: So more drivers can charge daily
questions.exKo: 더 많은 운전자가 매일 충전할 수 있도록 하기 위해서입니다.

questions.q: When will more charging points be added?
questions.exKo: 평균 이용률이 80%를 넘으면 4기를 추가합니다.

passages.title: 문서 보존 연한 정책 공지
passages.passage:
DOCUMENT RETENTION SCHEDULE — ANNUAL CLEANUP

The annual records cleanup runs November 3-14. Please review files in your team's shared drives against the retention schedule:

- Routine correspondence: delete after 2 years
- Project files: archive 5 years after project close
- Contracts and financial records: retain 7 years, then transfer to central archive
- Personnel records: managed by HR only — do not store copies locally

Archived items move to cold storage, retrievable within 24 hours on request. The legal team must approve any deletion involving ongoing disputes; when in doubt, tag the folder 'legal-hold' and it will be excluded automatically.

Storage costs fell 22 percent after last year's cleanup. Team compliance reports go to department heads December 1.

Records Management Office

questions.q: How long are contracts retained before transfer to the archive?
questions.exKo: 계약서와 재무 기록은 7년 보관 후 중앙 보관소로 이관합니다.

questions.q: What should staff do when unsure about deleting disputed files?
questions.exKo: 'legal-hold' 태그를 붙이면 자동으로 삭제 대상에서 제외됩니다.

questions.q: What was the result of last year's cleanup?
questions.exKo: 작년 정리 후 저장 비용이 22% 감소했습니다.

passages.title: 중소기업 사이버 보험 광고
passages.passage:
SHIELDLINE — CYBER INSURANCE FOR SMALL BUSINESS

One ransomware attack costs a small business an average of $85,000 — yet most policies were written for factories, not laptops. ShieldLine covers what modern businesses actually face: data breaches, payment fraud, and system downtime.

Coverage includes a 24-hour incident hotline, forensic specialists on site within two days, customer notification costs, and up to 30 days of lost-income protection. Our risk check, included free, scans your public systems and emails you a fix-it list before coverage even starts.

Policies from $60 a month for businesses under 50 staff. Answer twelve questions online and receive a quote in five minutes — no broker required. Protect your business at shieldline.com.

questions.q: What does the ad say about most existing policies?
choices: They were written for factories, not modern businesses
questions.exKo: 기존 보험은 노트북이 아닌 공장 시대에 맞춰 설계되었다고 지적합니다.

questions.q: What does the free risk check do?
choices: Scans public systems and sends a fix-it list
questions.exKo: 공개된 시스템을 점검해 개선 목록을 이메일로 보내 줍니다.

questions.q: How can a business get a quote?
questions.exKo: 온라인에서 12개 질문에 답하면 5분 내 견적을 받습니다.

passages.title: 사무실 이전 전문 업체 광고
passages.passage:
OFFICEShift — RELOCATION WITHOUT THE DOWNTIME

Moving 200 desks shouldn't mean losing a week of work. OfficeShift specializes in weekend office relocations: your team leaves Friday evening and starts Monday morning at the new address, everything connected and working.

Our crews label, pack, move, and reinstall workstations, meeting rooms, and server equipment — with an IT technician on every truck. We photograph each desk before packing and rebuild it exactly, down to the monitor angle.

More than 400 office moves completed, with an average business interruption of zero working days. Free site survey and fixed-price quote — no hourly surprises. Book at officeshift.com or call 555-0199.

questions.q: What is OfficeShift's specialty?
choices: Weekend office moves with no lost workdays
questions.exKo: 금요일 저녁부터 월요일 아침 사이에 끝내는 주말 사무실 이전이 전문입니다.

questions.q: Why is each desk photographed?
choices: To rebuild it exactly as before
questions.exKo: 모니터 각도까지 원래대로 재설치하기 위해 촬영합니다.

questions.q: What is stated about pricing?
choices: Fixed-price quotes with no hourly surprises
questions.exKo: 고정가 견적이라 시간당 추가 요금이 없습니다.

passages.title: 폐호텔 오피스 전환 기사
passages.passage:
DORSET CITY — The Grandview Hotel, closed for three years, will reopen in May as a flexible office building with 400 desks, developers announced Tuesday. Hotel rooms were combined in pairs to create private offices, while the ballroom becomes a shared event space.

The conversion cost roughly half of building new offices of similar size, and kept the 1920s facade that residents campaigned to protect. Pre-leasing has been strong: 70 percent of space is reserved, mostly by firms of two to twenty people leaving home-office setups.

The ground-floor restaurant will reopen to the public, and the former lobby bar becomes a cafe open to non-tenants. City planners say two more vacant buildings downtown are under study for similar conversions.

questions.q: What is happening to the Grandview Hotel?
choices: It is becoming a flexible office building
It is reopening as a hotel
questions.exKo: 폐업한 호텔이 400석 규모의 공유 오피스로 전환됩니다.

questions.q: What advantage did conversion have over new construction?
choices: It cost roughly half as much
questions.exKo: 신축 대비 절반 정도의 비용이 들었습니다.

questions.q: Who has mostly reserved the space?
questions.exKo: 재택 사무실에서 벗어나려는 2~20인 기업이 대부분입니다.

passages.title: 직원 추천 채용 확산 기사
passages.passage:
WORKFORCE REPORT — Employee referral programs now account for a third of new hires at mid-sized companies, up from a fifth five years ago, staffing analysts said this week. Companies pay bonuses of $500 to $3,000 for successful referrals, usually after the new hire completes six months.

The appeal is practical: referred candidates accept offers more often, start sooner, and stay longer — 18 months longer on average, one study found. Recruiting costs per hire drop as job-board and agency fees shrink.

Analysts warn of a downside: teams built heavily on referrals can become uniform in background and thinking. Some firms now cap referral hires per department or pair the program with wider outreach to keep candidate pools diverse.

questions.q: How have referral programs changed in five years?
choices: They grew from a fifth to a third of hires
questions.exKo: 추천 채용 비중이 5분의 1에서 3분의 1로 늘었습니다.

questions.q: When are referral bonuses usually paid?
choices: After the new hire completes six months
questions.exKo: 신입이 6개월 근속을 마친 뒤 지급되는 것이 일반적입니다.

questions.q: What risk do analysts point out?
choices: Teams may become uniform in background
questions.exKo: 추천 위주 채용은 팀 구성이 비슷해지는 위험이 있습니다.

passages.title: 계약서 서명 순서 확인 문자
passages.passage:
Amira Hassan (2:30 P.M.)
Legal approved the vendor contract with two small edits. Who signs first, us or them?

Felix Grant (2:33 P.M.)
Send it to them first — their CFO signs, then ours countersigns. Finance won't process the PO until both signatures are on it.

Amira Hassan (2:35 P.M.)
Got it. Their CFO is traveling until Thursday, though. The kickoff is Monday — is that a problem?

Felix Grant (2:38 P.M.)
Ask if they can sign electronically. Our system accepts e-signatures, and it takes five minutes from a phone.

Amira Hassan (2:52 P.M.)
They just confirmed — CFO will e-sign tonight. I'll route it to our side tomorrow morning.

Felix Grant (2:53 P.M.)
Perfect. Kickoff stays on schedule then.

questions.q: What is the required signing order?
choices: The vendor's CFO first, then our side
questions.exKo: 상대 CFO가 먼저 서명하고 우리 쪽이 반대 서명합니다.

questions.q: What problem did Ms. Hassan raise?
choices: The vendor's CFO is traveling until Thursday
questions.exKo: 상대 CFO가 목요일까지 출장이라 서명이 늦어질 상황이었습니다.

questions.q: How was the issue resolved?
choices: The CFO agreed to e-sign that night
questions.exKo: CFO가 당일 밤 전자 서명하기로 하여 일정이 지켜졌습니다.

passages.title: 매장 개점 준비 상황 문자
passages.passage:
Nina Park (7:40 A.M.)
Opening day minus 3! Status check: signage?

Leo Costa (7:45 A.M.)
Installed last night. Looks great — sending photos.

Nina Park (7:46 A.M.)
Saw them, love it. Card terminals?

Leo Costa (7:48 A.M.)
Both tested with real transactions this morning. Receipt printer needed a new roll, all set now.

Nina Park (7:50 A.M.)
Staff schedule for the weekend rush?

Leo Costa (7:52 A.M.)
Six on Saturday, five on Sunday. Two trained cashiers each day, and Mia can float between register and floor.

Nina Park (7:54 A.M.)
Last thing — the opening promotion signs mention the free tote with $50 purchase. We have 300 totes, right?

Leo Costa (7:55 A.M.)
320 in the back room, counted yesterday. We're ready.

questions.q: What are the two people preparing for?
choices: A store opening in three days
questions.exKo: 3일 뒤 매장 개점을 앞두고 준비 상황을 점검하는 대화입니다.

questions.q: What was fixed on the card terminals setup?
choices: The receipt printer needed a new roll
questions.exKo: 영수증 프린터에 새 용지를 넣어 해결했습니다.

questions.q: What is the opening promotion?
choices: A free tote with a $50 purchase
questions.exKo: 50달러 이상 구매 시 토트백 증정 프로모션입니다.
